# MyPVL public license search, captured 2026-09-02

URL: https://mypvl.dcca.hawaii.gov/public-license-search/

Rendered text of the page (JavaScript app; the raw HTML is a shell):

- Banner: "License information on this site reflects posted information in the
  Professional and Vocational Licensing Division as of 08/31/2026 ... This site
  is normally updated daily, Monday through Friday, except holidays".
- Tab 1 "License Number" search. Help text: "To search multiple license numbers
  at once, enter the license numbers separated by a comma. e.g.,
  ACU-12345,ACU-67890". Button "Submit".
  Results table columns: Name | License | License Type | Location
- Tab 2 name / license type search. Results table columns:
  Name | License | License Type | Location
- Tab 3 application status (SSN or file number + license type). Not used.
- License type select includes: DENTIST, DENTIST TEMP, COMMUNITY SERVICE DENTIST,
  DENTAL HYGIENIST, DENTAL HYGIENIST TEMP.

Hawaii dentist license numbers as they appear in NPPES taxonomy.license for
HI records: "DT-2878", "DT1513", "DT-1999", "DT-2153", "DT 939". Prefix DT.

No Socrata / bulk dataset exists. opendata.hawaii.gov "Professional and
Vocational Licensing (PVL) Search" is only an HTML link to this app.
DCCA also sells official lists of licensees ("Purchase Lists of PVL Licenses",
cca.hawaii.gov/pvl) which is the manual fallback.
